correctness.rationale: The cited characteristic-word identity supplies exact zeros/misses. Explicit induction on W_(h+1)=W_h^k1 verifies unit total, nonnegative prefix partial weights and maximum 1+h(k-1); each stage consists of q such blocks and one terminal negative symbol. Endpoints and attainment give sharp finite formulas. Stage positions grow as k^h for all fixed k>=2,q>=1 and imply logarithmic endpoints and density. 24-pair independent direct-recurrence comparisons (154770 positions) pass. No empirical claim substitutes for proof.

The full two-parameter stage extrema are not stated or dominated by this special case.

value.rationale: Natural arithmetic questions are the density and deterministic worst-case error for missing integers of hiccup sequences. Exact extrema at every full postorder stage and sharp lower/upper log slopes reveal negative, zero or positive lower drift and potentially large exceptional fluctuations that a first-order asymptotic or a central limit theorem cannot quantify. This is a useful finite-to-infinite structural result, not an arbitrary finite table or cosmetic renaming.
